limits: Bracket seeded from opening standings for controlled runtime diagnosis
Injury deliberately injected after actual qualifying source game to isolate payroll/medical reconciliation
nextImplementation: Prove club-specific final-game and term boundaries at the current medical period
Distinguish admitted continuing entitlement from genuinely disputed liability; expiry alone does not require a claim
Keep contract pay, postseason benefits, disputed claims and any voluntary payments separate
Version new receipts while retaining the recorded legacy accounting policy
Cover early elimination, nonparticipants, conference losers and finalists in actual applied-game and annual commands
Verify atomic previews/refusals, user/CPU decisions, named saves and purpose-specific service credit
legalInterpretationLimit: The observed code ignores its own proved term boundary. Appendix J expiry alone does not establish unlawful payments or disputed liability: Article 33 section 5(k/l) continues qualifying compensation while incapacity lasts. Independently reviewed diagnostic supports an integration/classification gap, not an automatic payment cutoff or grievance. Precise post-term payment, cap and service classification must be verified.
